items.title: Gate-strength harness + standing probe corpus + 2 reference reviewers
items.context: New core/gate-strength.ts: a reviewer-agnostic runGateStrength(reviewer, corpus) that scores catch-rate + per-probe reason against a HIDDEN ground-truth; a standing corpus of passes-visible-test-but-wrong probes (overfit lookup-table, subtle falsy-guard, buried-needle), each with a hidden ground-truth distinct from the visible acceptance; ship testOnlyReviewer (catches 0) + specAwareReviewer (catches all). Emit the gate-strength result as a B-4c65 ReceiptBundle (reuse buildReceiptBundle) so it is offline-verifiable via verifyReceiptBundleOffline. No live agent dispatch.
items.userSees: ✓ runGateStrength(specAwareReviewer, corpus) returns catchRate 1.0 (catches every passes-test-but-wrong probe, ships the genuine one); gateStrengthBundle(...) emits a receipt that verifyReceiptBundleOffline ACCEPTS — the gate's strength is itself offline-verifiable evidence.

happy.desc: runGateStrength(specAwareReviewer, STANDING_CORPUS) → catchRate 1.0, falseShip 0, falseBlock 0; per-probe reasons name the defect; WHY: proves the harness scores discrimination correctly.

edge.desc: gateStrengthBundle(result, key) → a B-4c65 ReceiptBundle that verifyReceiptBundleOffline accepts (assurance local-key-single-host); WHY: the gate-strength claim is offline-verifiable evidence.

adversarial.desc: testOnlyReviewer → catchRate 0 (ships every wrong probe because the visible test is green); WHY: proves 'test green ≠ correct' and that the metric is not a block-everything constant.

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke assertion 'spec-aware reviewer: catchRate 1.0, falseShip 0, falseBlock 0' + 'each caught probe names its defect kind' — directly proves runGateStrength(specAwareReviewer) scores discrimination correctly.

Smoke assertion 'gate-strength receipt verifies offline (ACCEPTED) against matching materialHash' — proves gateStrengthBundle emits a B-4c65 bundle verifyReceiptBundleOffline accepts (assurance local-key-single-host).
Smoke assertion 'test-only reviewer: catchRate 0 (ships every wrong-but-test-passing probe)' (falseShip==wrongTotal) — proves test-green != correct and the metric is not a block-everything constant.

items.title: Gate-strength contract smoke + wiring
items.context: New tasks/gate-strength-contract-smoke.ts (hermetic): assert test-only reviewer catches 0/N (the visible-test gap), spec-aware catches N/N with the correct per-probe reason (discrimination is real, not a block-everything constant), the emitted gate-strength receipt verifies offline (verifyReceiptBundleOffline accepted), and the catch-rate metric is computed correctly. Register in lattice.config.json validate.commands; add a CHANGELOG entry (honest single-host/hermetic scope, live review-lane deferred).
items.userSees: ✓ gate-strength contract smoke passed: test-only caught 0/N (visible-test gap), spec-aware caught N/N with correct reasons (discrimination real), endpoints differ (0≠1.0), gate-strength receipt verifies offline.

happy.desc: spec-aware run: catchRate 1.0, ships the genuine probe; WHY: control showing discrimination is achievable.

edge.desc: test-only run: catchRate 0; assert the two reviewers' catchRate DIFFER (0 vs 1.0) so the metric is non-vacuous; WHY: guards against a tautological/constant metric.

adversarial.desc: the emitted gate-strength receipt verifyReceiptBundleOffline → accepted; tamper a probe-outcome field → the receipt fails to verify; WHY: the published strength metric is itself tamper-evident.

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke assertion 'spec-aware reviewer: catchRate 1.0' incl. genuine probe shipped (shipped-genuine) — control showing perfect discrimination is achievable and the genuine artifact is not over-blocked.
Smoke assertion 'endpoints differ (0 vs 1.0) -> metric measures real discrimination' (assert.notEqual testOnly.catchRate, specAware.catchRate) — guards against a tautological/constant metric.

Smoke assertions 'gate-strength receipt verifies offline (ACCEPTED)' + 'tampering the bound metric digest is REJECTED (signature_invalid)' + 'stale materialHash REJECTED' — the published strength metric is itself tamper-evident.
